id: title:Gilbert09:show a recoverable message when an oauth callback state expires

review.posthog_relevance: Authentication and account security for OAuth integrations, specifically preventing state token mismatch attacks during the OAuth callback flow.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 replaces a silent exception with a user-facing error and redirect when the OAuth state token does not match the stored cookie. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and security improvement. It demonstrates a specific, observable change in authentication behavior rather than a narrow test or documentation update. The score is not elevated to 3,
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and its interaction with the broader OAuth flow are not fully visible; the benefit relies on the correctness of the surrounding state management and cookie handling, which are not shown in this chunk. No evidence of actual adoption or incident avoidance is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a test file and P1.F2.H1 is the implementation. The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 is the relevant change. P1.F1.H1 is not an implementation hunk and should not be scored. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces a silent throw with a user-facing error and redirect when OAuth state token does not match the cookie.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents a forged or expired OAuth state from successfully creating an integration, improving account security and user experience during OAuth callbacks.
